turns.content: Consider the two-body decay pi+ -> mu+ + nu in the pion rest frame. Treat the neutrino as massless, use m_pi=139.6 MeV/c^2 and m_mu=105.7 MeV/c^2, and determine the kinetic energies of the muon and neutrino in MeV.
Starting from energy and momentum conservation in the pion rest frame, derive the daughter-energy relations in terms of m_pi and m_mu before inserting numbers.
Use those relations to compute the muon total energy, retaining enough digits for the subtraction of its rest energy.
Compute T_mu from the muon total energy and T_nu under the same massless-neutrino assumption, then report the ordered pair (T_mu,T_nu).
Use the neutrino energy to obtain the common daughter-momentum magnitude, then verify that the muon total energy satisfies its relativistic energy-momentum relation.
Independently compute the decay Q value m_pi-m_mu and compare it with T_mu+T_nu as a numerical consistency check.
State the final ordered kinetic-energy pair (T_mu,T_nu) in MeV and summarize the conservation relations that determine it.
